answer: Behavioral Entropy Scoring works by recording each identity's action sequence over a fixed horizon and comparing its entropy against population baselines. Enforcement uses a discrepancy test: identities whose entropy falls below a calibrated threshold are flagged, and any resources they touch are frozen pending review, regardless of registration price. The residual opal-weighted security derives from passive logging, yet a sybil operator must now pay to simulate varied behavior across every clone, raising marginal cost well above a single basalt mining pass.
